text: Ombudsman Kwame Addo and Deputy Ombudsman, Housing, Reema Patel, will provide an update on the investigative and consultation work carried out by Ombudsman Toronto’s Housing Unit over the past six months.

The Housing Rights Advisory Committee: 1. Requested the Housing Secretariat provide an update to the Housing Rights Advisory Committee at its meeting on September 16, 2025 on the mapping availability of resources, services and support for tenants who are at risk of displacement and also an update on the status of the Housing At-Risk Table.
